SIHF Team shootouts per season

Source: R/sihf.R
sihf_team_shootouts.Rd

Team shootouts per season: shootout wins and losses, attempts, goals and percentage, and attempts, goals against and saves.

Reads the Swiss Ice Hockey Federation statistics API (data.sihf.ch, keyless JSON). SIHF keys a season by its END year (2026 = 2025-26). An unknown season, league_id or phase_id is never an error upstream (SIHF silently answers another one), so every table answer is checked against the body's own filter echo and refused when it differs. Every request is spaced at least one second from the last one to the host.

Usage

sihf_team_shootouts(season, league_id = 1L, phase_id = NULL, language = "en")

Arguments

season

Required. Season by its END year (2026 = 2025-26). A season SIHF does not have raises fastRhockey_no_data error (the API itself silently answers another one).

league_id

SIHF league id: 1 = National League, 2 = Swiss League, 100 = MyHockey League, 3 = 1. Liga, 43 = SWHL B, 113 = U21-Elit (the body's League filter lists them). An id SIHF does not have for the season raises fastRhockey_no_data error.

phase_id

SIHF phase id (regular season, a playoff round, ...; the body's Phase filter lists them). NULL = no phase filter: the season summary over every phase.

language

Response language. Only part of the body is translated: status, position and penalty names stay German.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble with 18 columns. A zero-row tibble with these columns when the payload holds no rows.

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason by its END year (2026 = 2025-26), from the body's echo of the Season filter.
phase_idintegerSIHF phase id (regular season, a playoff round, ...); null unless a phase filter is passed.
rankintegerRank in the table; null on a summary row, and on a goaltender below the qualification line.
team_idintegerSIHF team id (integer join key); null on a summary row (the pseudo-team 100000).
team_namecharacterTeam display name as SIHF publishes it; "Durchschnitt" on the league-average row, "Total" on the attendance total row.
team_acronymcharacterTeam abbreviation as SIHF publishes it (e.g., "HCD"); null on a summary row.
games_playedintegerGames played in the table's scope.
games_won_penaltyintegerGames won in a shootout.
games_lost_penaltyintegerShootout losses.
pen_shotsintegerShootout/penalty shots taken.
pen_shot_goalsintegerShootout/penalty goals.
pen_shots_missedintegerShootout/penalty shots missed.
pen_shots_percentnumericShootout/penalty conversion percentage.
pen_shots_againstintegerShootout/penalty shots faced.
pen_shot_goals_againstintegerShootout/penalty goals allowed.
pen_shot_savesintegerShootout/penalty shots saved.
pen_shot_saves_percentnumericShootout/penalty save percentage.
row_typecharacter"data" for a regular row; "average" (league average) or "total" (attendance total) for a summary row SIHF mixes into the table.

Errors

  • fastRhockey_no_data: SIHF answered 404 (unknown game), or ignored a requested season, league or phase and served another one.

  • fastRhockey_bad_request: SIHF answered 400 / 422, or an argument is invalid.

  • fastRhockey_asset_fetch: any other non-2xx answer or a dead connection after retries, an empty or unreadable body, a stub or redirect body, a table without its filter echo, a truncated table, or a gameoverview body for another game.
